questions.question: Bobtail tractors are ____ to stop than tractors with full semitrailers attached.
questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor has no semitrailer attached. Bobtails are harder to stop and need more distance to come to a complete stop than a tractor pulling a loaded semitrailer.

questions.question: What is road rage?

options.text: Driving with intent to harm other people
Driving a vehicle that is unsafe
Driving a vehicle that has not been inspected

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving with intent to harm other people
questions.explanation: Aggressive driving is selfish, bold, or pushy driving. Road rage is driving with intent to harm other people or damage their vehicle.

questions.question: When should you slow down for a curve?
questions.explanation: Always slow to a safe speed before entering a curve. Slowing while in the curve can cause your vehicle to skid.

questions.question: When you start your vehicle, the coolant temperature should:

options.text: Jump quickly from low to high

questions.explanation: Watch your vehicle's gauges before driving. After starting the engine, the coolant temperature should rise gradually to normal operating range.

questions.question: Front tire tread depth must be at least ____ in every major groove.
questions.explanation: Front tires must have a tread depth of 4/32 of an inch in every major groove. Other tires must have a tread depth of 2/32 of an inch.

questions.question: When making a left turn, you should start the turn:

options.text: Before reaching the center of the intersection
At or after the center of the intersection
After your rear wheels have passed the center of the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: At or after the center of the intersection
questions.explanation: Wait until you reach the center of the intersection before turning left. If you turn too early, the left side of your vehicle could hit another driver.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:
questions.explanation: Change lanes slowly and smoothly. This gives other drivers time to move or alert you with their horns. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: When parked on a flat surface, you should:

options.text: Use wheel chocks to prevent your vehicle from moving
Use wheel chocks only if you have applied the parking brake

questions.correctAnswerText: Use wheel chocks to prevent your vehicle from moving
questions.explanation: Use wheel chocks when parking on a level surface. This is essential if your vehicle does not have spring brakes.

questions.question: When driving, it is important to:

options.text: Plan how to handle dangerous situations
Turn your head all the way around instead of using mirrors

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan how to handle dangerous situations
questions.explanation: Scan the road for hazards. Plan what you will do if a hazard becomes an emergency.

questions.question: Anti-lock brake warning lights are:
questions.explanation: Vehicles with anti-lock brakes have yellow warning lights. These lights show when there is a problem with the braking system.

questions.question: On flat surfaces, wheel chocks:

options.text: Stop a parked vehicle from rolling.
Make a parked vehicle roll more easily.
Should only be used on the front driver's side tire.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop a parked vehicle from rolling.
questions.explanation: When a driver cannot use the parking brake, wheel chocks can hold a parked vehicle in place on a flat surface.

questions.question: In a dual air brake system:

options.text: Both systems share the same air tanks.
Each system has its own air tanks.
You must choose which system to use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Each system has its own air tanks.
questions.explanation: A dual air brake system has two separate brake systems. Both systems share the same brake controls, but each has its own tanks, hoses, and lines.

questions.question: Pre-trip inspections are:

options.text: Only needed for trips longer than 100 miles.

questions.explanation: Federal and state laws require drivers to inspect their vehicles before every trip, no matter how long the trip is.

questions.question: What kind of brakes do most newer heavy-duty trucks use?
questions.explanation: Most newer heavy-duty trucks use dual air brake systems. This system has two separate brake systems that share one set of brake controls.

questions.question: When trying to put out an electrical fire, you should:
questions.explanation: B:C fire extinguishers work on electrical fires and burning liquids. Never pour water on an electrical fire.

questions.question: Which is NOT a recommended way to spot trouble?

options.text: Checking critical items only at the start and end of a trip

questions.correctAnswerText: Checking critical items only at the start and end of a trip
questions.explanation: Check your vehicle regularly during a trip. Watch the instrument panel and gauges. Look at your mirrors. Check the tires, cargo, and lights. Use all your senses and watch for any sign of trouble.

questions.question: If you cannot reverse your trailer in a straight path, you should:

options.text: Swerve back and forth while backing.

questions.explanation: If you cannot back straight, back on a curved path toward the driver's side. This gives you the best view while backing.

questions.question: Brakes out of adjustment will:

options.text: Cause some brakes to overwork and fail.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cause some brakes to overwork and fail.
questions.explanation: Out-of-adjustment brakes will fail before properly adjusted ones. Check brake adjustment often to prevent brake problems.

questions.question: The "crack-the-whip" effect is caused by:
questions.explanation: Vehicles with trailers can roll over due to the "crack-the-whip" effect, which is caused by rearward amplification. Know the rearward amplification of your vehicle.

questions.question: Before a trip, ensure that the fifth wheel is:
questions.explanation: When inspecting the converter dolly, check that all parts are present and working. Check the upper and lower fifth wheel, air lines, and electric lines. The fifth wheel should be properly greased and securely mounted.
